title.en: Simply supported bridge load-path beam model

summary: Compute reactions and one section response for declared point loads on a simply supported beam without presenting the result as structural design approval.
objective: Build a bridge cutaway where moving point loads update equilibrium reactions and a chosen-section influence line, with applicability and units always visible.
example_prompts: Move two axle loads across a simply supported deck and inspect reactions and moment at one section.
negative_signals: Not FEA, code load rating, safety factor, stress capacity or real bridge certification.
not_for: No continuous spans, distributed/self weight unless explicitly added, dynamics, shear deformation, plasticity or support uplift.

entities.name: Beam and supports
entities.guidance: Blender authors a dimensioned centerline/deck shell, pin/roller symbols and section marker; the mathematical span remains a 1D line.

entities.name: Load and equilibrium ledger
entities.guidance: Three.js owns load magnitudes/positions, reactions and section response; arrows are scaled presentation with numeric labels.

state_contract.model: One massless simply supported beam spans x in [0,L], L>0. Each downward point load Pi>=0 applies only when xi is within [0,L]; off-span loads contribute zero and remain visually separate. Static equilibrium gives RA=sum Pi*(L-xi)/L and RB=sum Pi*xi/L. For section a in (0,L), the unit-load moment influence ordinate is y(x)=x*(L-a)/L for x<=a and y(x)=a*(L-x)/L for x>=a; section moment M(a)=sum over on-span loads Pi*y(xi); off-span loads contribute zero to reactions and moment. Reactions and M are quasi-static response values, not capacity checks.
state_contract.authority: Three.js owns SI inputs, applicability, equilibrium and influence evaluation. Blender owns bridge/deck/support presentation; decorative trusses do not enter the beam model.
actions: Move a finite point load along or outside the span.
Add/remove a bounded load and recompute reactions/moment atomically.
Move the section marker and rebuild its influence line.
Reset to one unit load at midspan.

invariants: RA+RB equals total on-span downward load within tolerance.
Taking moments about either support balances within declared force-length tolerance.
Off-span loads contribute exactly zero and are labeled outside applicability.
Influence superposition uses the exact current load snapshot.
motion_guidance: Play, pause and step advance the declared model clock only; reset restores parameters, state, solver budget, selections, errors and presentation transforms.
Use static before/after states and numeric tables for reduced motion; animation interpolates committed state and never supplies physical evidence.
creative_affordances: Blender may shape distinctive apparatus, cutaways and materials; Three.js binds named parts to authoritative state and keeps units and error states readable.
Camera, color, trails and deformation gain are presentation controls and cannot change the numerical model.
known_limits: Pedagogical statically determinate 1D beam only; no suitability, capacity, serviceability, traffic-code or safety conclusion.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no Blender export, numerical simulation, contact solve, browser or renderer was run.

claims.statement: An influence line shows how one specified structural response varies as a unit load traverses a structure; response functions include support reaction, shear, moment and deflection at a specified point.

For a simply supported beam, equilibrium determines support-reaction influence ordinates and section moment; responses to several point loads are summed from load times the corresponding influence ordinate.
claims.scope: Linear quasi-static simply supported beam under declared point loads.

source_refs.locator: Sections on influence lines for reactions and moment, and multiple concentrated loads

object_craft.structure: Keep the exact span centerline and supports visible beneath any stylized deck; attach load sliders and a section plane to model coordinates.
object_craft.material: Use distinct arrow shapes for applied load and reactions and a signed ordinate plot beside the deck.

physical_contract.scope: Quasi-static equilibrium and one-section influence response of a simply supported beam.
physical_contract.timestep: No dynamics; every input edit recomputes a snapshot.
